[OptiDose](https://doi.org/10.1007/s10928-022-09840-w) is an approach based on control theory that estimates optimal doses fulfilling a predefined therapeutic goal. Since doses can be treated as a bioavailability to estimate, OptiDose was further implemented in [NONMEM](https://doi.org/10.1007/s10928-024-09940-9) and [Monolix](https://doi.org/10.1002/jcph.6188).

To facilitate the implementation of OptiDose in pharmacometric software and make it more accessible, we created the R package [optiDoseR](https://github.com/braemd/optiDoseR). This package automatically generates the required code and data sets for the implementation of OptiDose in Monolix, NONMEM, and nlmixr2.
